card.name: Just before 'val' in drug terms
card.fires_on: The piece of text right before a 'val' or 'VAL' chunk begins, such as the OL in estradiol valerate, SO in SOVALDI, or the slash in bag/valve. Seen in drug names and device terms.

modes.label: Before -VAL- in drug names
modes.description: Last piece of a name just before 'val' starts, as in sofosbuvir brand name SOVALDI or estradiol valerate.
modes.example: WHAT IS THE MOST IMPORTANT INFORMATION I SHOULD KNOW ABOUT ESTRADI<<OL>> VALERATE INJECTION, USP

modes.label: Slash before valve
modes.description: The slash in 'bag/valve' mask ventilation, where 'valve' comes next.
modes.example: equipment for bag<</>>valve/mask assisted ventilation must be

modes.label: Other val-starting terms
modes.description: Opening of terms like valganciclovir or levulinate where the next piece starts with 'val' or 'vul'.

card.writes: It boosts 'val' pieces as the next text, such as in valerate, valve and valganciclovir.
card.plain: It fires when the next piece of text is likely to begin with 'val', as in SOVALDI, valerate or valve.
